parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "chat_id": "{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.telegram_chat_id }}",
  "parse_mode": "Markdown",
  "text": "🚨 *TIKET GANGGUAN SISTEM BARU*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎫 *Nomor Tiket*: `{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.ticket_number }}`
👤 *User*: `{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.user_id }}` ({{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.user_name || 'Pelanggan' }})
⚠️ *Kategori*: {{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.category }}
🛠 *Fitur Terkendala*: *{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.feature_name }}*
⚡ *Urgensi*: {{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.urgency.toUpperCase() }}

📝 *Detail Kendala*:
"{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data.description }}"

💬 *ID Percakapan*: `{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.conversation_id }}`
🕒 *Waktu*: {{ new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' }) }} WIB
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
_Mohon tim internal segera memeriksa dan menindaklanjuti kendala ini._"
}

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "success",
  "conversation_id": "{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.conversation_id }}",
  "reply": {{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Response').item.json.reply) }},
  "intent": "{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.intent }}",
  "confidence": {{ $('Extract Response').item.json.confidence }},
  "parameters": {{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Response').item.json.parameters) }},
  "pii_sanitized": {{ $('Extract Response').item.json.pii_sanitized }},
  "is_ticket_report": {{ $('Extract Response').item.json.is_ticket_report }},
  "ticket_number": "{{ $('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_number }}",
  "ticket_data": {{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Response').item.json.ticket_data) }}
}
